title: Símbolos dos Dados — legenda da p.102
scopeLimits: This proposal covers only the DICE SYMBOLS / BOOK / SHIELD / BURST legend row. Other p.102 labels, diagram symbols, and prose remain separate units.

Four existing source fragments are grouped as separate typographic units on one shared baseline; each PT frame starts at the source word x-coordinate and ends at the next source word slot. No spacing characters or font/frame edits force line count.

The original 10 pt Optima hierarchy, color, source block ID, line IDs, and source glyph geometry are preserved. Three translated siblings pass one-line frame fit in the live Viewer; the BURST PT diagnostic region is blank under an open DTP exception. PDF export remains pending.
No human translation, human decision, final PT-BR value, or Payload record was modified.

note: The source PDF and DOM fragments group to one visual baseline at y=552.55 pt. Three PT-BR labels pass exact line-count and source-slot fit; BURST remains a complete proposal with a blank diagnostic PT region because EXPLOSÃO overflows its original slot.

revisions.result: v1 single-frame layout failed Copyfit V3: one source baseline became two PageRenderer rows; EXPLOSÃO escaped the frame at 100% and 200%.
revisions.decision: Split the already separate source text fragments into four existing typographic-unit structures, preserving their source x slots and shared baseline. This is an additive metadata change; no source text, IDs, art, existing translation, or Payload record is changed.
revisions.rollback: Remove the added typographicUnits array from block_21 and use the preserved v1 proposal; no other source DOM fields were modified.

revisions.result: The live Viewer confirmed the four source fragments share one baseline. Initial PT measurement exposed cumulative vertical reflow and horizontal overflow for EXPLOSÃO.
revisions.decision: Mark the four same-baseline typographic units fixed-position so they do not flow sequentially. Keep the full EXPLOSÃO proposal, open a unit-scoped DTP exception, and blank only that PT diagnostic field.
revisions.measurement: PDF 1 visual line; PageRenderer PT-BR 1 visual line (EXACT). At 200%, the source slot is 19.60 CSS px and EXPLOSÃO measures about 30.075 px; no font or frame change is permitted.
revisions.rollback: Remove the p.102 burst exception by ID and restore the proposal candidate's previous diagnosticRendering/technicalStatus. Remove fixedPosition from the four p.102 legend units only if the units are no longer co-baseline fixed labels.

revisionReconciliation.notes: As revisões dos símbolos BOOK, SHIELD e BURST foram reconciliadas com o Payload por /translation-review/approve; as publicações anteriores ficaram no histórico. Os três alvos têm símbolo semântico inline e Copyfit V3 EXACT em 100% e 200%.
